summary.text: Mike Giallombardo is a Republican member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 79, first elected in 2020.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biographical page, Giallombardo is a tech entrepreneur who lives in Cape Coral and served 13 years in the U.S. Army Reserve and Florida Army National Guard as a chief warrant officer, including Operation Iraqi Freedom.
Giallombardo holds degrees from Georgia Military College, Florida Atlantic University and American Military University.
